track.title: Homayoun: Daramad
track.notes: Tagged title: Daramad Homayoun. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on F in Daramad. The line peaks at Gk4 (375.7 Hz) at 0:00.5. It closes on the tonic (Gk3 → Gk4 → Gk4 → Gk4 → F4 → F4).
